title: Agent Teleshko needs to see your documents

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: You there. I need to talk to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You there. I need to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: I need to see your CZ11A.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to see your CZ11A.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Proof of ownership for your noodle stand. I need to see it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Proof of ownership for your noodle stand. I need to see it.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: You need to show me the documents I demand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You need to show me the documents I demand.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: You'll give it to me now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll give it to me now.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: There used to be a hotdog stall here, right on this spot. Helen... something-or-other sold the saltiest, nastiest dogs in Nivalis. I don't normally eat junk food, but I made an exception for Helen's hot dogs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There used to be a hotdog stall here, right on this spot. Helen... something-or-other sold the saltiest, nastiest dogs in Nivalis. I don't normally eat junk food, but I made an exception for Helen's hot dogs.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Helen lost her hotdog stand because she let her permits lapse. She asked me if there was anything I could do. Could I make an exception, just this one time? Let her off the hook.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Helen lost her hotdog stand because she let her permits lapse. She asked me if there was anything I could do. Could I make an exception, just this one time? Let her off the hook.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: She was. And when she was deported to the factory districts, I really missed those hot dogs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was. And when she was deported to the factory districts, I really missed those hot dogs.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: Because I was doing what she wasn't: my fucking job. And when she was deported to the factory districts, I really missed those hot dogs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because I was doing what she wasn't: my fucking job. And when she was deported to the factory districts, I really missed those hot dogs.

nodes.speaker: Agent Teleshko
nodes.text: You'd better find it. I liked Helen's hot dogs, and she's long gone. Your food is trash. Have a good day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'd better find it. I liked Helen's hot dogs, and she's long gone. Your food is trash. Have a good day.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm busy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm busy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, I'll get that to you soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, I'll get that to you soon.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sure, I'll get that to you soon.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sure, I'll get that to you soon.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll have a look for it later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll have a look for it later.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll have a look for it later.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll have a look for it later.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have to show you anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have to show you anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have to show you anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have to show you anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Or what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't sell hot dogs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't sell hot dogs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you get to the point?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you get to the point?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can you get to the point?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can you get to the point?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She was asking the wrong person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was asking the wrong person.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She was asking the wrong person.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She was asking the wrong person.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not give her more time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not give her more time?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why not give her more time?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why not give her more time?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have any documentation for the business.
